**Version and environment**

Asimi version, Windows build and architecture, and provider mode if relevant.

**Steps**

How can the problem be reproduced with a disposable project or test fixture?

**Expected and observed behavior**

Include the relevant redacted error or diagnostic. Remove credentials, project source, local paths, and private screenshots before posting.

For security vulnerabilities, follow the private reporting instructions in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Axiu112530/Asimi/blob/HEAD/SECURITY.md).
